Generate Python code based on the following instruction. Output ONLY code. DO NOT include explanations or other textual content.
Instruction: Generate code that uses the pyaedt library to create a flex cable CPWG (coplanar waveguide with ground) in HFSS. The code should first import necessary libraries and set the non-graphical mode. Then, it should launch AEDT in a specified version and solution type, and set some properties such as material override, automatically use causal materials, open region, model units, and initial mesh. 

Next, the code should define variables for the flex cable CPWG, including total length, theta, radius, width, height, spacing, ground width, and ground thickness. It should also define a function to create a bending based on the curvature radius and extension.

The code should then draw a signal line and a ground line to create a bent signal wire and two bent ground wires respectively. It should also draw a dielectric to create a dielectric cable, and create bottom metals. 

Afterwards, the code should create port interfaces (PEC enclosures) and a Perfect E boundary condition. It should also create ports and a setup and sweep with specified properties. 

Finally, the code should plot the model and release AEDT.

You can find the following APIs from the library helpful:
test_54b_open_and_load_a_polyline, hfss3dl_a, point_a, icepak_a, move_and_connect_to, get_version_and_release, duplicate_and_unite, duplicate_and_mirror, set_position_and_rotation, create_port_between_pin_and_layer, test_09b_export_report_A, get_position_and_rotation, _update_segments_and_points, clean_cache_and_files, check_and_download_folder, check_and_download_file, enforce_dc_and_causality, array_center_and_edge, create_sheet_to_ground, test_54a_create_spiral_and_add_segments

```python
import pyaedt
from pyaedt import Hfss
from pyaedt.generic.constants import unit_converter

# Set non-graphical mode
pyaedt.settings.non_graphical = True

# Launch AEDT in specified version and solution type
aedt_version = "2024.1"
project_name = "Flex_CPWG"
design_name = "CPWG_Flex"
solution_type = "DrivenModal"

hfss = Hfss(projectname=project_name, designname=design_name, solution_type=solution_type, specified_version=aedt_version, new_desktop_session=True)

# Set properties
hfss.material_override = True
hfss.modeler.use_causal_materials = True
hfss.modeler.create_open_region(Frequency="10GHz")
hfss.model_units = "mm"
hfss.mesh.assign_initial_mesh()

# Define variables for flex cable CPWG
total_length = 100  # mm
theta = 45  # degrees
radius = 30  # mm
signal_width = 1.0  # mm
signal_height = 0.035  # mm
spacing = 0.2  # mm
ground_width = 2.0  # mm
ground_thickness = 0.035  # mm
dielectric_height = 0.2  # mm
dielectric_material = "Polyimide"

hfss["total_length"] = "{}mm".format(total_length)
hfss["theta"] = "{}deg".format(theta)
hfss["radius"] = "{}mm".format(radius)
hfss["signal_width"] = "{}mm".format(signal_width)
hfss["signal_height"] = "{}mm".format(signal_height)
hfss["spacing"] = "{}mm".format(spacing)
hfss["ground_width"] = "{}mm".format(ground_width)
hfss["ground_thickness"] = "{}mm".format(ground_thickness)
hfss["dielectric_height"] = "{}mm".format(dielectric_height)

# Function to create a bent polyline (arc + straight)
def create_bent_line(hfss, name, start, length, theta, radius, width, height, mat, axis="Z"):
    # Arc segment
    arc = hfss.modeler.create_polyline(
        [
            start,
            [start[0] + radius, start[1], start[2]],
            [start[0] + radius, start[1] + radius, start[2]]
        ],
        cover_surface=False,
        close_surface=False,
        xsection_type="Rectangle",
        xsection_width=width,
        xsection_height=height,
        name=name + "_arc"
    )
    # Straight segment
    end_arc = [start[0] + radius, start[1] + radius, start[2]]
    straight = hfss.modeler.create_polyline(
        [
            end_arc,
            [end_arc[0] + (length - 3.1415 * radius * theta / 180), end_arc[1], end_arc[2]]
        ],
        cover_surface=False,
        close_surface=False,
        xsection_type="Rectangle",
        xsection_width=width,
        xsection_height=height,
        name=name + "_straight"
    )
    # Unite arc and straight
    hfss.modeler.unite([arc, straight])
    hfss.modeler[arc].material_name = mat
    return arc

# Draw signal line
signal_start = [0, 0, dielectric_height + signal_height / 2]
signal_line = create_bent_line(
    hfss, "Signal", signal_start, total_length, theta, radius, signal_width, signal_height, "copper"
)

# Draw ground lines (left and right)
ground_offset = signal_width / 2 + spacing + ground_width / 2
ground_left_start = [0, -ground_offset, dielectric_height + ground_thickness / 2]
ground_right_start = [0, ground_offset, dielectric_height + ground_thickness / 2]

ground_left = create_bent_line(
    hfss, "GND_Left", ground_left_start, total_length, theta, radius, ground_width, ground_thickness, "copper"
)
ground_right = create_bent_line(
    hfss, "GND_Right", ground_right_start, total_length, theta, radius, ground_width, ground_thickness, "copper"
)

# Draw dielectric
dielectric_length = total_length + 2
dielectric_width = 2 * (ground_offset + ground_width / 2) + 1
dielectric_box = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    [-1, -dielectric_width / 2, 0],
    [dielectric_length, dielectric_width, dielectric_height],
    name="Dielectric"
)
hfss.modeler["Dielectric"].material_name = dielectric_material

# Create bottom metals (ground plane)
bottom_plane = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    [-1, -dielectric_width / 2, 0],
    [dielectric_length, dielectric_width, ground_thickness],
    name="Bottom_GND"
)
hfss.modeler["Bottom_GND"].material_name = "copper"

# Create port interfaces (PEC enclosures)
pec_box1 = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    [-2, -dielectric_width / 2 - 1, 0],
    [1, dielectric_width + 2, dielectric_height + signal_height + 1],
    name="PEC1"
)
pec_box2 = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    [total_length + 1, -dielectric_width / 2 - 1, 0],
    [1, dielectric_width + 2, dielectric_height + signal_height + 1],
    name="PEC2"
)
hfss.modeler["PEC1"].material_name = "pec"
hfss.modeler["PEC2"].material_name = "pec"

# Assign Perfect E boundary to PEC enclosures
hfss.assign_perfecte_to_sheets(["PEC1", "PEC2"])

# Create wave ports
port1 = hfss.create_wave_port_from_face(
    hfss.modeler["PEC1"].faces[4],  # front face
    axisdir=hfss.AxisDir.XNeg,
    name="Port1"
)
port2 = hfss.create_wave_port_from_face(
    hfss.modeler["PEC2"].faces[5],  # back face
    axisdir=hfss.AxisDir.XPos,
    name="Port2"
)

# Create setup and sweep
setup = hfss.create_setup("Setup1")
setup.props["Frequency"] = "10GHz"
setup.props["MaximumPasses"] = 10
setup.props["MinimumPasses"] = 1
setup.props["MinimumConvergedPasses"] = 1
setup.props["PercentRefinement"] = 30
setup.props["BasisOrder"] = 1
setup.props["MinimumFrequency"] = "1GHz"
setup.props["MaximumDeltaS"] = 0.01
setup.update()

hfss.create_linear_count_sweep(
    setupname="Setup1",
    unit="GHz",
    freqstart=1,
    freqstop=20,
    num_of_freq_points=101,
    sweep_type="Interpolating"
)

# Plot the model
hfss.plot(show=True)

# Release AEDT
hfss.release_desktop(close_projects=True, close_desktop=True)
```
